title: ProviderDynamicCapabilities
$comment: streamingAvailable and cancellationAvailable are tri-state on purpose: true, false, or absent. Absent means 'inherit the static declaration' and is a distinct state from both booleans. They must never become nullable: null would be a fourth state no consumer handles, and bridges omit the key specifically to preserve 'absent'.
description: A provider's live capability check, evaluated on the current host when routing or when checkCapabilities() is called. Unlike the descriptor it can change between calls.

available.description: Whether the provider is available and functional on this host right now.

reason.description: Why the provider is unavailable, when available is false.

streamingAvailable.description: Whether the provider can stream (Mode 2) on this host right now. Absent inherits the static descriptor.supports.streaming value; only set it when the host takes streaming away from a provider that otherwise declares it. Never null.

streamingUnavailableReason.description: Why streaming is unavailable, when streamingAvailable is false. Absent lets the route planner synthesize a default message.

cancellationAvailable.description: Whether cancellation is honored on this host right now. Absent inherits the static descriptor.cancel value: any value other than 'none' means available. Never null.
